passages.text: Atractylis cancellata, known by the common name cage thistle, is a species of annual herb in the family Asteraceae. They have a self-supporting growth form and simple, broad leaves and dry fruit. Individuals can grow to {{convert|2|cm|in|abbr=on}} tall.
